verdict.rationale: Fly.io's deploy workflow (fly launch via flyctl) does auto-detect app type and generate config, showing some no-manual-config capability, but the evidence never describes a GitHub 'connect repo' integration or push-to-deploy pipeline like PaaS competitors—deployment is CLI-driven, not repo-connection driven. missing for 10: evidence of a repo-connect/GitHub App deploy flow, evidence of zero-config detection without CLI setup, independent confirmation of build auto-configuration working reliably.
